19:13 < jal0> i did notice that the method indexes are encoded different depending on if the function uses an implicit handle or not
19:14 < andrey> either positive or negative?
19:14 < jal0> #define METHOD_CALL(mid)        (FIRST_METHOD + (mid)*APICALL_SCALE)
19:14 < jal0> #define IMPLICIT_CALL(hid, mid) (FIRST_METHOD - ((hid)<<HANDLE_SHIFT | (mid))*APICALL_SCALE)
19:15 < jal0> these are apperantly the two types of calls that can be made with Native API's
19:17 < andrey> handle ID and method ID?
19:17 < jal0> i think, but still not sure at this point :(
19:18 < andrey> probably first macro is for in-kernel methods and second one is for registered servers
19:18 < jal0>  * method index for handle based APIs or a handle index and method
19:18 < jal0>  * index pair for an implicit handle API call.
19:18 < jal0>  */
19:18 < jal0> in psyscall.h
